scope: CPU reconstruction of historical FA_CODE factors and dense metric; not a GPU policy-parity test
mathematical_construction: U = last-two eigenvectors multiplied by sqrt(last-two eigenvalues); M = I + U U^T; historical degenerate heads would use M=0 and exported U=ridge=0
backend_caveat: The historical continuation builds dense M on CPU before CUDA transfer. The new CUDA reference rebuilds dense M from CUDA factors. Exact CPU/factor equality does not by itself establish CUDA policy parity. scripts/check_metric_backend_parity.py is the separately preregistered supplemental check.
